hints.content: $\sqrt[3]{216}$ is the number that, when multiplied by itself three times, equals $216$.
If you can't think of that number, you can break down $216$ into its prime factorization and look for equal groups of numbers.

Let's draw a factor tree.

hints.content: So the prime factorization of $216$ is $2\times 2\times 2\times 3\times 3\times 3$.
We're looking for $\sqrt[3]{216}$, so we want to split the prime factors into three identical groups.

Notice that we can rearrange the factors like so:

 $216 = 2\times 2\times 2\times 3\times 3\times 3 = \left(2\times 3\right)\times\left(2\times 3\right)\times\left(2\times 3\right)$
